project.storage.tip1.group: 30    工程设置 › 存储设置    ·    project.storage
project.storage.tip1.zh: 1、选择“删除文件优先”当磁盘空间不足时，会删除录像时间最早的录像文件。
project.storage.tip1.en: 1. Delete Oldest: When disk space is insufficient, the oldest recordings are deleted.
project.storage.tip1.original: 1. Select "Delete Priority" when the disk space is insufficient, the video file with the earliest recording time will be deleted.
project.storage.tip1.note: 与策略选项一致，明确删除顺序。

project.storage.tip2.group: 30    工程设置 › 存储设置    ·    project.storage
project.storage.tip2.zh: 2、选择“停止录制优先”当磁盘空间不足时，会停止当前录制。
project.storage.tip2.en: 2. Stop Recording: When disk space is insufficient, the current recording stops.
project.storage.tip2.original: 2. Select "Stop Priority" to stop the current recording when there is not enough disk space.
project.storage.tip2.note: 与策略选项一致，保留触发条件。
